# langfuse_project_membership (Resource)

Manage project membership using organization-scoped credentials. The user must already be a member of the organization. Destroy removes project membership, not the user or organization membership. Import format: project_id,user_id,organization_public_key,organization_private_key. Import credentials are stored in state.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "project_id" {
  type = string
}

variable "member_email" {
  type        = string
  description = "Email of an existing organization member."
}

variable "organization_public_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

variable "organization_private_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

resource "langfuse_project_membership" "example" {
  project_id               = var.project_id
  email                    = var.member_email
  role                     = "MEMBER"
  organization_public_key  = var.organization_public_key
  organization_private_key = var.organization_private_key
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email` (String) The email address of the user to add to the project.
- `organization_private_key` (String, Sensitive) Organization private key to authenticate the call.
- `organization_public_key` (String, Sensitive) Organization public key to authenticate the call.
- `project_id` (String) The ID of the project.
- `role` (String) The role to assign to the user. Valid values are: OWNER, ADMIN, MEMBER, VIEWER, NONE.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the project membership.
- `name` (String) The name of the user.
- `user_id` (String) The unique identifier of the user.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Avoid putting literal credentials in shell history.
terraform import langfuse_project_membership.example "${PROJECT_ID},${USER_ID},${ORGANIZATION_PUBLIC_KEY},${ORGANIZATION_PRIVATE_KEY}"
```
